questions.question: Which कृदन्त is formed from हस्?
questions.explanation: The Book 1 formation table pairs हस् with हसनम्.

questions.question: Which धातु produces पठनम्?
questions.explanation: The table pairs पठ् with पठनम्.

questions.question: Which कृदन्त is formed from स्मृ?
questions.explanation: स्मृ + the taught formation produces स्मरणम्.

questions.question: Which कृदन्त is formed from दृश्?
Which कृदन्त is formed from गै?
questions.explanation: The vowel-ending धातु गै produces गानम्.

questions.question: Which कृदन्त is formed from दा?
Which कृदन्त is formed from कृ?
Which कृदन्त is formed from गम्?
Which कृदन्त is formed from बुध्?
Which कृदन्त is formed from रक्ष्?
questions.explanation: The listed कृदन्त of रक्ष् is रक्षणम्.

questions.question: According to the कृदन्त lesson, the taught भाववाचक nouns decline like which model?
questions.explanation: The taught कृदन्त words are neuter and decline like वनम्.

questions.question: Which grammatical gender is assigned to these taught अन-ending कृदन्त nouns?
questions.explanation: The lesson identifies these भाववाचक nouns as नपुंसकलिङ्ग.

questions.question: Complete the transformation: अहम् ईशं स्मरामि। → अहम् ईशस्य _____ करोमि।
questions.explanation: The lesson provides अहम् ईशस्य स्मरणं करोमि।

questions.question: In अहम् ईशस्य स्मरणं करोमि।, which case is ईशस्य?
questions.explanation: The lesson contrasts ईशं (द्वितीया) and ईशस्य (षष्ठी).

questions.question: Which is the taught कृदन्त expression corresponding to सिंहः गर्जति।?
questions.explanation: The lesson gives सिंहः गर्जनं करोति। as its paired expression.
